ogseamus:

I got the unlock over the weekend. Unfortunately I was using my tablet, so here is the best I can remember.Ambuscade vs Unity, Captain Cosmic, PW Argent Adapt, The Adamant Sentinels in Freedom Tower

 

This post seems to make clear that ( A) three-hero teams aren't necessary, and (B) fighting Chokepoint isn't necessary.  

 

But, has everyone seen this?  (Steam Community :: Screenshot :: Variant get! Got it with 3 person team (SS Tachyon, Omnitron X, Unity) vs Ambuscade on Wagner Mars Base.)  Screenshot from a successful unlock on Steam by Dedlok, who theorizes:  " Get all 15 of her Golems on the Field and have them all out on the field for a full turn at full HP. Used Wagner Base for the Meteor Swarm card (no cards can do damage) and Ambuscade because he has nothing that can affect the environment. "

 

Since they're in Wagner Base, then (C) playing in Freedom Tower isn't necessary.   More importantly, though, I think it's proof that the  "# of Unity equipments = # of villain cards in play" theory is incorrect:  

Looking at Unity's picture in the lower right of the screenshot, she has 18 cards in play (12 cards in hand), but according to Dedlok, 15 of those cards are bots, which means Unity only has 3 Equipments in play.   Ambuscade has 5 cards in play (6 if you count his character card), so I don't think the number of villain cards vis-a-vis Unity Equipments in play has anything to do with it.

But, perhaps it isn't " # of Unity's equipments = # of villain cards " but " # of ALL hero equipments = # of villain cards "?  In the unlock screen shot, Unity has 3 equipments in play.  Tachyon has three cards in play, one of which is (probably) the HUD Goggles, which would be 4 Equipments.  Given Omni-X's deck, he probably has at least one Equipment in play, which would be 5 Equipments – the same number of cards that Ambuscade has in play.  (Or if it's "total number of cards in villain play area," then Omni-X with 2 Equipments in play would equal 6 total hero Equipments.)  That would also make the unlock condition susceptible to modification by Unity, since she can destroy hero equipments to even out the numbers if need be.  So my new Theory #1 is:

 

Unity must be on the team.  At the beginning of the villain turn, the number of hero Equipment cards in play must equal the total number of villain cards in play (or "cards in the villain's play area") (or maybe "villain targets in play").  (Note:  This can't be the whole condition; it's too easy.  But maybe it's in combination with a number of bots Unity must have in play, or that she must have played certain cards, or destroyed/repurposed a certain number of bots?)

 

Alternately, there's Dedlok's theory about putting all of Unity's bots in play and having them at max HP at the beginning of the villain's turn.  I think we've disproved that Unity needs to have all of her bots in play; several people have unlocked without having all of the bots in play.  But, what if, rather than all of her bots, there is a certain number of bots that need to be in play and at full HP at the beginning of the villain turn?  Maybe something like:

 

Unity must be on the team.  At the beginning of the villain turn, Unity must have more bots in play than the number of villain cards in play/villain targets in play/cards in the villain's play area, and all of the bots must be at full HP.

OK, I just got the unlock, and I can definitively say that it doesn't have anything to do with Powered Shockwave – that was the one card in Unity's entire deck that I didn't play the entire game.  I'm pretty sure now that it has something to do with destroying Supply Crate (or some equipment), bringing out a bot, then putting a bot back in the hand using Scrap Metal, because all of those happened both on my "unlock" turn and on your "unlock" turn.  

I tried to duplicate your successful run exactly.  Same team/conditions (Visionary, Grandpa Legacy, Unity vs. Ambuscade in Freedom Tower).  Just like you did, I went through Unity's deck methodically until I had just about all of her bots out, as well as a bunch of equipment.  Along the way, I played/used every card in her deck except Powered Shockwave – I was saving those up to use at the end as my attempt to finish the game like you did.  

I wanted to set up my "unlock" turn so I could do what you did.  (Destroy a Supply Crate to draw cards, play Powered Shockwave and Scrap Metal, use Workbench to play a BeeBot, then use Scrap Metal to take the Bee Bot back in my hand, and possibly, get the environment to play Supply Crate for me right before Ambuscade's turn.)   So, with 90% of my setup ready, all I did on that turn was the following, never expecting it to do anything: 

(1) Kill Ambuscade's cloaking device with Turret Bot (The only card he had in play.)

(2) Play Supply Crate and Scrap Metal (There wasn't one of either in play yet)

(3) Used Bot-Hack to destroy Supply Crate and play Bee Bot

(4) Wasted a bunch of bot damage on a still-invisible Ambuscade

(5) Used Supply Crate to put Bee Bot back in my hand (intending to play it next round for the "unlock").  

The environment didn't play any additional Unity cards (only one-shots were left in the deck to be played).  

When Ambuscade's turn came, he flipped, and I immediately got the unlock.  So it happened not only without playing Powered Shockwave on that turn; it happened without playing Powered Shockwave at all.  I put a more detailed breakdown of the turn at the end. (Since I'm on iOS, there is no log file, correct?)  But for now, here's my current theory:

 

Unity must be on the team.  On Unity's turn, she must destroy a Supply Crate (or possibly just "destroy an Equipment"?), put a Mechanical Golem into play, and put a Mechanical Golem back into her hand, all in the same turn.   (Plus possibly an additional condition like "She must have X bots in play," or "She must have Y Equipments in play," or "She must have played X, Y, and Z cards at some point during the game.") 

 

DETAILED BREAKDOWN OF UNLOCK TURN:
